title: Kid Friendly American Mac and Cheese Casserole
description: A classic comfort food dish that is easy to make and always a hit with kids. Perfect for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk together to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, stirring occasionally.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the cheddar cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked macaroni, salt, and pepper to the cheese sauce and stir until well combined.
Transfer the macaroni mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
If using, sprinkle crushed crackers on top of the macaroni.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
